# AzbyGames

> AzbyGames is an independent game development studio founded by ZroDump. Its first game is Quizagon, a real-time multiplayer trivia game.

Website: https://azbygames.com/
Contact: contact@azbygames.com

## Primary pages
- [AzbyGames homepage](https://azbygames.com/): studio overview, Quizagon and contact information.
- [Türkçe](https://azbygames.com/tr/): Turkish-language overview.
- [Quizagon](https://azbygames.com/#games): official first-party information about the game.

## Notes
Quizagon store links will be added when the game is released. No release date, download count, ratings, or app store listing is claimed here.
